cipa.reconstruction: public-reference reconstruction; measured layout and explicitly selected parameters

documented.active_area: 300x200 mm, official CIPA instructions; 340x240 cropped frame excludes A3 paper margin/footer
documented.frequency: 200-2500 LW/PH, five black lines; P1 200-1500, P2 1400-2500, official CIPA descriptions
documented.lengths: 96.55 mm main wedge, 37.711 mm peripheral wedge, approximately 7 mm per 100 LW/PH for sweeps, visible old dimensional drawings A.4/A.5

measured_or_inferred.layout: manual measurements from original 3307x2340 illustration in CIPA instructions; main wedge origins/angles, squares and sweep placement
measured_or_inferred.reference_circles: radii read from old dimensional drawing A.3

selected.wedge_formula: linear local frequency versus axial distance; stripe boundaries u=(k +/- 0.5)*H/f(s), k=-4,-2,0,2,4. Ideal formula rather than tracing aliased preview contours
selected.quiet_zones: white margins around patterns prevent reference-circle interference; dimensions selected
selected.labels_focus: font, text placement and six-cycle focus wheel reconstructed; no certified positional tolerance

esfr2024.reconstruction: public-reference reconstruction; measured layout and explicitly selected parameters

documented.edge_reflectance: 0.20/0.05 and four-cycle 5-degree structure from indexed 2024 table C.1; 4:1 independently corroborated by IS&T and QA100
documented.star_side_mm: 25% of active height in indexed table C.1

measured_or_inferred.star_centers: 2022 authors paper Figure 13; inferred 4:3 diagonal-normalized field positions reproduce preview centres
measured_or_inferred.oecf_positions: staggered 16-patch arrangement and numbering measured from Figure 13 and QA100 preview
measured_or_inferred.registration: three asymmetric circles measured from Figure 13

selected.oecf_endpoints: synthetic 20:1 range, QA100 product contrast; 16 log-spaced values are our choice, not claimed ISO14524 sequence
selected.focus: dual-density quadratic zone plate formula and 5 mm radius selected to resemble preview; not measured focus transfer

ssfr.reconstruction: public-reference reconstruction; measured layout and explicitly selected parameters

documented.cell_star_markers_patches: publicly accessible 2014 reference, Annex E table E.2: 290x270 mm, star diameter 250 mm, marker/patch coordinates
documented.modulation: 144 cycles; 72-cycle alternative and 18% background, old Annex E and indexed 2024 E.1; primary vendor data independently corroborate cycle counts
documented.patch_levels: equally spaced in linear reflectance, 16 steps from bright to dark

measured_or_inferred.grid: 3x3 arrangement from authors paper and old Figure E.1; 100 mm horizontal gaps estimated from relative star-centre spacing
measured_or_inferred.centre_mask: radius 1/10 of outer star radius estimated from authors Figure 8
measured_or_inferred.top_right_marker: white-hole y=6 mm follows visible symmetry in Figure 8; old E.2 lists y=0, so this is a recorded override

selected.reflectance: 0.9 / 0.009 (100:1), synthetic endpoints, within publicly documented high-contrast range; not measured material values
